# SectionLink

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders linked text that navigates to a named section in the document.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `Hyperlink`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new SectionLink(text: string, anchorTarget: string, options?: SectionLinkOptions)
new SectionLink(options: SectionLinkOptions & { text: string; anchorTarget: string; })
```

## Properties

- [`anchorTarget`](#anchortarget): The anchor id this link jumps to (a `Section` or anchored `Heading`).

### `anchorTarget`

```typescript
anchorTarget: string
```

The anchor id this link jumps to (a [`Section`](section.md) or anchored [`Heading`](heading.md)).

## Methods

- [`render`](#render): Resolves `anchorTarget` to a 0-based page index from the seeded TOC registry, then delegates to the base `Hyperlink` render/annotation path.

### `render`

```typescript
render(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): void
```

Resolves `anchorTarget` to a 0-based page index from the seeded TOC registry, then delegates to the base [`Hyperlink`](hyperlink.md) render/annotation path. Falls back to the first page when the target was never registered (unknown id / single-pass layout), matching the VisualToc behaviour.

- `ctx`: The render context
- `width`: The available width
